At "Aojishi Valley," where satoyama (traditional village-managed forest) environments are being restored, rice is grown in revived fallow paddies.

【Fees】Adults ¥3,000 | Students ¥2,000 | Preschool children ¥1,500 (includes guide, insurance, and tools)

【Capacity】15 people

【Guide】Mori no Field School staff

【What to bring】Drinks, lunch, work gloves, towel, hat, change of clothes, rubber boots

【More information】Mori no Field School website: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
